- 189 Rust tests (5 opt-in tests excluded from the ordinary suite), 107 frontend

## Platform acceptance record

2026-10-05 用户在收到明确的两项验收问题后回复“确认啊 怎么还有问题 不是说修复通过直接发布吗”。据此记录：本次 Mac 包对应 5c05309（或仅文档不同的 293a1d4），原生公证检查、安装启动、ima 两入口切换与恢复通过；当前 Windows 安装版的手工模型切换与恢复通过。Windows 界面结果来自用户确认，不冒充自动化点击通过。

These confirmations complete platform acceptance, not an exception for a known
failure. Public deployment, merge CI, tag, workflow and final download evidence
are recorded in the website's `doc/releases/v3.15.2.md` as they complete.
